content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts consistently overestimate prices, showing upward bias in early periods.", "Sentiment shifts from bullish to bearish as event net supply increases, triggering downward forecast corrections.", "Forecast lags in response to recent auction supply, especially when bullish sentiment declines.", "Mean-reversion patterns emerge after high forecast peaks, aligning with true outcomes in mid-to-late periods.", "Forecast accuracy improves when sentiment remains stable despite supply shocks.", "Model underestimates price volatility during high bearish sentiment and rising supply net.", "Forecast overshoots are most pronounced when bullish sentiment is high and supply is low.", "Sentiment and supply net interact to override forecast trends, especially in late periods."]}
